profile.text: Muelsyse, Director of Rhine Lab's Ecological Section and a leading expert on life and environmental science in Columbia. She got in touch with Rhodes Island during the Trimounts incident, after which she entered into a long-term partnership agreement with us. She now works on multiple collaborative research projects with the Bioengineering Lab, as well as participating in relevant operations as a Vanguard operator.
